blurb: Guests fish in the spacious bay system of Panama City Beach, known for redfish, speckled trout, sheepshead, bluefish, and black snapper. Tarpon fishing is a highlight from May through August, especially June and July, with fish ranging 70-200 lbs. There are specialized trips for kids and shark fishing targeting 3-6 ft sharks on light tackle.
